rules.accepted_credit_types: APA-, CPA-, NASP- or ACCME-approved providers, or Board-approved providers (prior approval otherwise); full-day conferences by non-approved providers up to 3 h each, max 6 h per biennium
rules.new_licensee_rule: New licensees are deemed compliant for the rest of the fiscal year of licensure; if the next fiscal year (July 1 - June 30) is a reporting year, only 10 hours are required.
rules.audit_note: CE reported in the Board's online system by June 30 of odd years; random audit of at least 5% of reports.
rules.notes: Two-year CE period ends June 30 of odd-numbered years; license itself renews annually by June 30. Ethics hours = professional ethics or legal issues in psychological services.
